name: Moto Guzzi V7 (2008-on)
engine: 744 or 853 cc air-cooled transverse V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Moto Guzzi's modern retro twin. Shaft drive and a simple air-cooled engine. Some 2017 V7 IIIs had a brake hose recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2017 V7 III models are in recall 17V380 (front ABS brake hose can rub and leak).
A-002.reason: A brake fluid leak cuts front braking. The fix is free.

G: Balance the two throttle bodies after any work on them.

recalls.what: Front ABS brake hose may rub on the secondary air connection and leak.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a hose mount and replaces any damaged hose free.
